axes.name: pointer_declaration
axes.rationale: The target PauseGame and SetPause have no local frame and select the far-call argument through AX plus DS. The existing near-pointer temporary creates enter 2,0 in both bodies. Vary only the temporary pointer type/register declaration to see whether C7 removes those frame bytes while preserving the branch and call shape.
